reportTitle: BLIND HISTORICAL VALIDATION TEST #1 — CURRENT-EVIDENCE YEAR-AGNOSTIC AGE-BAND ADJUSTED REPORT
interpretation: This is a current-evidence, year-agnostic anonymous validation. It is not a point-in-time historical reconstruction and does not use or infer an athlete draft year.

reportSections.title: Athlete evidence inventory
reportSections.content: The supplied position, exact JR source code, current age, physical attributes, handedness, school, rankings, scouting grades, and summer-league statements are preserved. No name, athlete ID, draft year, or Draft Result is present.

content.finding: Sequential filtering falls from 3,041 catchers to 428 C+JR records, 47 after exact height, 3 after exact weight, 2 after batting hand, 2 after throwing hand, 1 after exact school, and 0 after exact MLB rank. Therefore the exact all-fields cohort is not used as an individualized forecast.
content.ageHandling: Age is not part of the exact-match filter chain. Both fixed bands are nested only within the base catcher population.

content.limitation: Exact MLB rank 173 has one historical record across all positions and zero in the fully nested cohort. Perfect Game and Baseball America rankings remain descriptive because their ranking rows are not safely identity-joined to draft_players.

content.finding: Height 71 inches (38.61% drafted), bats R (37.87%), and throws R (37.82%) are close to the catcher population drafted share of 38.38%. Weight 215 has a lower observed drafted share of 33.85%. These are parallel factual comparisons, not causal effects.

reportSections.title: Class and age findings
reportSections.evidenceClass: verified_public aggregate retrieval plus unavailable-age limitation

content.finding: JR remains an exact source-code comparison. For supplied current age 20.9, the catcher population within 20.4–21.4 contains 656 records with 248 drafted (37.80%); the 19.9–21.9 band contains 992 records with 441 drafted (44.46%). The base catcher population is 3,041 with 38.38% drafted. This is an approximate current-age-to-age-at-draft comparison, not a draft-date reconstruction.

reportSections.title: Summer-league findings and limitations
reportSections.evidenceClass: verified_public aggregate retrieval plus OSM-supplied profile facts

content.finding: No Coastal Plain or Northwoods production league rows were found, so those supplied facts remain profile evidence only. Cape non-participation is stated as supplied and is not inferred from database absence or used as a negative comparison.

slotValueCoverage.note: Slot values are available as production evidence but are not attached to anonymous profile cohorts without a supported pick/round relationship.

content.finding: Reported bonus coverage is 23.97% in the catcher population and 73.36% in catcher+JR. Slot values exist but cannot be attached to this anonymous profile without a supported pick or round relationship.

reportSections.title: Meaningful differentiating factors demonstrated by evidence

demonstrated.observation: 93.13% drafted across 5,257 records; 92.06% across 428 catcher+JR records versus 38.38% across 3,041 catchers.

Within the catcher population, ±0.5 contains 656 records with 37.80% drafted; ±1.0 contains 992 records with 44.46% drafted; catcher baseline is 38.38%. Fixed tolerances were selected before outcomes were observed.

limited.observation: 33.85% drafted across 2,118 all-position records; no causal conclusion.
40.00% drafted across 80 records; close to the 40.49% full evidence-base share.
One all-position record and zero in the fully nested cohort; insufficient for a distribution.

content.caution: No formal materiality or minimum-sample threshold has been approved. Age uses fixed bands and historical age_at_draft, while the supplied value is current/profile age; differences are arithmetic, approximate, non-causal, and non-predictive.

reportSections.title: Market assessment
reportSections.evidenceClass: DiamondIQ evidence synthesis constrained to retrieved aggregates
reportSections.content: The current evidence supports a broad market-context assessment, not an individualized Draft Result forecast. The catcher comparison population is 3,041 records with 38.38% drafted. Exact JR status is the strongest observed separator in available data, but the exact all-supported-attribute cohort is zero and ranking coverage is sparse.

reportSections.title: Opportunities
reportSections.evidenceClass: DiamondIQ evidence synthesis constrained to retrieved aggregates
content: The exact JR cohort is strongly associated with drafted records in this evidence base.
The catcher+JR population remains large enough to expose a multi-outcome distribution before additional exact physical filters collapse the sample.
Reported bonus evidence is available for 314 of 428 catcher+JR records, enabling documented compensation context without imputing missing values.

reportSections.title: Risks
reportSections.evidenceClass: DiamondIQ evidence synthesis constrained to retrieved aggregates
content: Exact-filter attrition reaches 47 records after height, 3 after weight, 2 after handedness, 1 after school, and 0 after MLB rank.
MLB rank coverage is sparse; Perfect Game and Baseball America ranks cannot be safely joined to outcomes.
Coastal Plain and Northwoods datasets are unavailable; Cape absence cannot be used as negative evidence.
The JR result may reflect source composition and cannot be treated as a causal class effect.
Age comparison is approximate because current/profile age 20.9 is compared with historical age_at_draft without an inferred draft date.

reportSections.title: Leverage and decision environment
reportSections.content: No individualized leverage conclusion is supported. Bonus and slot evidence provide market context, but the anonymous profile has no supported pick, round, offer, or contract relationship. The evidence supports comparison and uncertainty disclosure only.

reportSections.title: Evidence gaps
content: No exact same-definition historical current-age field; fixed bands compare current/profile age 20.9 approximately against historical age_at_draft.
No safe Perfect Game or Baseball America ranking-to-outcome join.
No Coastal Plain or Northwoods outcome-comparison dataset.
No negative-inference basis for Cape non-participation.
No supported anonymous-profile slot or offer relationship.

reportSections.title: Overall DiamondIQ assessment
reportSections.evidenceClass: DiamondIQ evidence synthesis constrained to retrieved aggregates
reportSections.content: Current production evidence identifies exact JR class code as the clearest observed historical separator for this anonymous catcher profile. The fixed age bands provide additional transparent context: ±0.5 is close to the catcher baseline, while ±1.0 has a higher observed drafted share, but the age basis is approximate and non-causal. Because the fully filtered cohort is zero and several supplied evidence types are unavailable or unlinked, DiamondIQ does not assign a probability, similarity score, predicted Draft Result, or individualized leverage conclusion.
